detail.longDescription: @anders@thoresson.social I'm using #Kubernetes at work and #Proxmox at home and I'd say the fundamental difference is that Proxmox provides a way to run VMs and LXC containers with storage and some failover inside the cluster but is grounded in local CLI tools and the web UI. While k8s tries to provide everything possible with extensibility and a dedicated remote API. I often run into cases where k8s already has solutions, but want to avoid the complexity at home.
